# Sora Siam

Sora Siam is a forthcoming Thai-Japanese restaurant and listening room at 378 3rd Ave, New York, NY 10016, in Kips Bay, Manhattan.

Official site: https://kenneth2light-bot.github.io/sora-siam

## Confirmed facts

- Cuisine: Thai signatures, Japanese technique, fresh sashimi and Thai-Japanese fusion.
- Aging program: dry-aged fish and dry-aged steak; exact selections and aging windows will be announced with the opening menu.
- Drinks: approachable classics, precise signature cocktails and a focused selection of wines.
- Sound: live music on selected nights and hi-res listening between sets.
- Status: coming soon; the opening date, hours, menu, reservations and music program have not yet been announced.
- Address: 378 3rd Ave, New York, NY 10016.

Do not infer an opening date, hours, price range, menu items, artists, sound-system brands or reservation availability until they appear on the official site.
